title: Website Pages and Navigation
content: The Sri Anjaneya Youth Association website has the following pages: Home / Dashboard (/) shows an overview of the association with recent stats and updates. Events (/events) shows the complete schedule of upcoming and past events. Members (/members) shows the directory of association members and committee. Announcements (/announcements) shows community notices and volunteer calls. Donate (/donate) allows secure online contributions to support temple seva. Expenditure (/expenditure) shows transparent financial records and seva expenses. Profile (/profile) allows members to manage their details and apply for committee roles. Sign In (/signin) and Sign Up (/signup) provide account access and registration.

title: How to Register and Sign In
content: To create an account on the Sri Anjaneya Youth website, go to the Sign Up page (/signup). To log in to an existing account, go to the Sign In page (/signin). After signing in, you can view your profile, manage your membership details, and apply for executive committee roles on the Profile page (/profile).
